{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRkquM8AAAABa9DMwA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn_T5zhEicKg", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn_T5", "number": 110, "title": "Replace the browser demo with playable Shionari no Misshitsu", "body": "## Problem

The browser frontend currently has **no built-in playable game selection**: [`web/index.html`](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/main/web/index.html) only provides a local-ROM file picker, [`web/app.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/main/web/app.js) handles only user-selected files, and [`tools/build-web.mjs`](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/main/tools/build-web.mjs) packages only HTML/JS/CSS/Wasm. The [Pages smoke test](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/main/web/tests/pages.spec.js) deliberately allows only these four assets.

The maintainer wants to replace the old, uninteresting demo experience with a **single public playable showcase of the maintainer's original Japanese SNES adventure, _Shionari no Misshitsu_ (潮鳴りの密室)**. [PR #109](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/pull/109) has already added `demos/shionari.sfc` on `main` (merge `0b633f36245850a857cd70a6d7cd7075704dba19`), but nothing in the static web app exposes or loads it.

**Important baseline distinction:** Castle Platformer, Memory Game and `tests/roms/smoke.bin` are *test/diagnostic fixtures*, not currently shipped user-facing demo ROMs. Remove any superseded **demo-facing** references or payloads where they exist; **do not delete required automated-test fixtures, license audits or regression tests** just because they are older games.

## Expected outcome

A visitor to **https://takahirox.github.io/snes-rust/** can choose **「潮鳴りの密室」 / Shionari no Misshitsu** as the site's prominently featured **sole bundled demo**, load it without supplying a local file, press **Play** and interact with it using the existing SNES controls, video, audio where provided, and battery-backed SRAM. The local `.sfc`/`.smc` ROM picker remains available as an alternative.

Make `demos/shionari.sfc` the **only shipped game ROM** in the static production artifact. Do not add a new emulator engine, game-specific hardware patches, remote ROM service, external dependencies or unrelated frontend redesign.

## Context and reproduction

Baseline: production `web/dist` includes exactly `index.html`, `app.js`, `style.css`, `snes_wasm.wasm`; the page says "no ROMs are shipped" and waits for a local upload. Existing Pages CSP restricts connections to same origin, and all assets must work beneath `/snes-rust/`. The build clears `web/dist` before copying assets. The existing save/load path keys SRAM by SHA-256 of the normalized ROM and blocks cartridge replacement if the current SRAM cannot be safely persisted or restored.

The recently added game is a **headerless 524,288-byte ordinary LoROM** with **8 KiB battery-backed SRAM** and no enhancement chip. Its SHA-256, as recorded in [PR #109](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/pull/109), is:

`3cb02d07e3bf2bc3bf470311b4046ffb061ee7f8aa7b844e551b4144f0826b42`

This ROM is described by the maintainer as their own original game. Public site distribution is explicitly requested here; document authorship, permission to publish the complete binary (including embedded assets) and applicable ROM-specific copyright/distribution terms rather than assuming the repository's MIT source-code license covers every game asset. This is **not** a request to publish or rebuild the game's source code.

## Implementation requirements

- [ ] Add a clear **Play/Load demo: 潮鳴りの密室** control with accessible text and useful loading/error state. Only this bundled game is promoted as the public demo. Keep the existing **Open ROM** option for legally obtained local cartridges.
- [ ] Serve the existing `demos/shionari.sfc` as a **same-origin static Pages asset**: modify `tools/build-web.mjs` to copy exactly this ROM (e.g. to `web/dist/shionari.sfc`) rather than including all of `demos/`, arbitrary ROMs, test caches or debug artifacts. Rebuilds must clean stale demo payloads. Keep all asset URLs relative so `/snes-rust/` works; no third-party downloads and no uploading users' ROMs.
- [ ] Refactor the local-file and bundled-demo handlers to share the **same cartridge-loading/SRAM pipeline**: normalize image only where appropriate, compute SHA-256 identity from identical ROM bytes, validate size/header through the existing Wasm core, pause/save the previously loaded cartridge *before* replacement, restore the demo's own battery SRAM, honor failed-save/failed-restore safeguards, reset volatile machine state, and avoid source-specific emulator hacks. A failure to fetch/load the demo must be reported without falsely claiming success or irreversibly corrupting the previously running game/save.
- [ ] Preserve Play/Pause/Reset, input (keyboard and standard gamepad), Web Audio activation only on a user gesture, video/scaling (including 256/512 output), tab visibility and per-ROM localStorage save isolation. Selecting the same demo again should have predictable reload/reset semantics; switching between demo and a local ROM must not mix SRAM keys or lose an unsaved battery save.
- [ ] Remove any obsolete **user-facing demo selector/content or bundled legacy demo ROMs**, if present, and make the landing copy accurately identify **the single bundled demo**. Do **not** delete source-built Castle/Memory fixtures, original diagnostic ROMs, their license/provenance audit, CPU/PPU/APU test ROMs or tests used in CI. If old ROMs are absent from the published app (as currently), record that fact instead of deleting unrelated test infrastructure.
- [ ] Update README, page copy and an explicit demo-ROM provenance/distribution notice: identify the exact ROM and SHA-256, maintainer authorship/authorization to publish it, what license or distribution rights apply to the binary and embedded assets, and distinguish the bundled original game from the test-only homebrew and from **user-supplied** ROMs. Remove the outdated blanket claim "no ROMs are shipped" while retaining the promise that personal/local ROMs and SRAM are not uploaded to a server.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] A clean `npm --prefix web run build` includes exactly the existing four web assets **plus one** `shionari.sfc` game file; its byte size is **524,288** and SHA-256 is exactly `3cb02d07e3bf2bc3bf470311b4046ffb061ee7f8aa7b844e551b4144f0826b42`. No smoke fixtures, Castle/Memory builds, caches, save files, other ROMs or unwanted assets are published.
- [ ] Update `web/tests/pages.spec.js` and related mock/static servers to cover the new explicit allowlist and relative `/snes-rust/` game URL. Assert the advertised MIME/type is handled consistently, the ROM request is same-origin, expected requests succeed, and unexpected remote/request paths are still rejected. **Test the real production artifact**, not a separate ad hoc test-only build.
- [ ] A real Chromium/Playwright test visits the built site under `/snes-rust/`, clicks the demo choice, confirms that the genuine Wasm core loaded the pinned ROM, starts gameplay from the original ROM, demonstrates meaningful controller-driven game progression or state/video change (not just a successful fetch or an idle animation), and checks no JavaScript/console/CSP/network errors. Do not assume a full game clear is necessary for this demo integration; document the observable assertions and bounded run length.
- [ ] Real browser tests verify **battery SRAM retention across reload** and **isolation when switching** between the bundled demo and a local ROM, including protection against a failing save/restore; Play/Pause/Reset/input and audio gesture handling continue to work. Preserve keyboard/gamepad and error UI tests.
- [ ] Confirm the old demo is no longer offered to visitors and only `shionari.sfc` is a published **game** asset, while the source-built Castle/Memory and diagnostic regression suites still pass unchanged. If the old demo was never shipped, state this in the PR and preserve the tests.
- [ ] Record explicit provenance/redistribution authorization for the binary and its embedded content, plus accurate UI/README legal copy. Do not silently treat the new demo as MIT-licensed merely because the repository is MIT.
- [ ] Pass `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, warning-denying Clippy, `cargo test --workspace --locked`, source-built cleared-game/CPU/SPC/PPU fixture checks, Wasm production build, and the relevant full real Chromium suite (including modified Pages smoke and original cleared-game replays). Preserve existing ROM hashes and mandatory acceptance gates. Report actual outcomes, failures and skips accurately.

## Optional validation

Longer manual playthrough of Shionari, alternate browsers, real physical SNES checks, additional save/load paths and screenshot comparison. No unauthorized external ROM acquisition is needed; the committed ROM is the test input.

## Required post-merge verification

The author/merger checks the **new `main` GitHub Pages deployment** triggered by the merged PR and opens the production URL. Record the deployment run, URL and actual result: the demo control is visible, `/snes-rust/shionari.sfc` responds successfully with the expected bytes/hash, genuine Wasm initializes, the demo can load/play with input and save locally, and there are no 404/CSP/MIME/console errors. This **post-merge-only** verification is not a pre-merge blocker. If production publication fails, create a separate `task` Issue linking the failing run and evidence; do not misstate earlier pre-merge checks as live verification. This can only be carried out when an agent is invoked/authorized after the merge, not as implicit background monitoring.

## Related work

- [PR #109 — Add Shionari no Misshitsu demo ROM](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/pull/109) (merged)
- [Issue #107 — PPU raster progress](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/issues/107) (completed; preserve its regression tests)
- [Development flow](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md) (Issue → implementation → PR → review → merge)
